title: Purchase Order Material Reconciliation
purpose: Prove composite supplier-material mapping, purchasing item identity, safe review behavior and replay after an approved cross-reference change.

sequence.point: Golden PO items resolve supplier material codes with full coverage.
Table and headers drift safely; supplier material VEND-Q9 is unresolved for supplier SUP-2000.
Reviewer approves the scoped supplier-material mapping to MAT-471103.
Supplier-material cross-reference receives a new released version.
The same PO source replays with pinned updated reference data.

assertions: Purchasing Document + Item is the stable row identity for this case.
Supplier Material alone is not a safe global key; Supplier + Supplier Material is required.
A candidate mapping observed in a PO row is evidence, not automatic master data.
Header and table movement may be recoverable without changing business logic.
Reference changes are versioned and linked to a decision.
Replay records exact procedure and reference versions.
